title: spec/01-architecture.md:27 SCHC '6-15 bytes' contradicts normative 23-37 (R-01-003)
description: Found during 3x codereview of b7z9.205 (appendix-design-rationale SCHC figure fix, now landed). spec/01-architecture.md:27 says 'SCHC compresses headers to 6-15 bytes' — no rule in any stack reaches 6-15 bytes (minimum is 21 B for Rule 7 link-local mode); normative spec/03-adaptation.md 5.3 table says Rule 0 link-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP = 23 bytes, Rule 1 Yggdrasil = 37 bytes. Already flagged divergent in docs/spec-coverage/01-architecture.md (R-01-003). Fix: reword line 27 to the normative 23/37 figures with link-local/Yggdrasil terminology. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.205.
